grid_event_type.finding: GridEvent ALREADY carries organizer (OrganizerSchema.nullable().optional()) and attendees (z.array(AttendeeSchema).readonly().optional()) at lines 86-88. No data plumbing or type widening is required to reach the grid cards — the badge can read event.attendees directly.

constraints: SEMANTIC COLORS ONLY. `bun lint` runs packages/scripts/src/testing/check-semantic-colors.ts BEFORE biome and hard-fails (exit 1) on any raw Tailwind palette class (bg-blue-300, text-zinc-900, --color-red-500, darkBlue-*) anywhere under packages/web/src. Use bg-success / bg-error / bg-warning / bg-text-subtle — these are declared in packages/web/src/index.css lines 114-125.
Cursor rule .cursor/rules/web-styles.mdc has glob packages/web/**/*.{tsx,css} and restates the semantic-color rule; .cursor/rules/web-testing.mdc governs the test file.

Grid cards are dense, size-constrained UI. TimedEventCard already gates the repeat icon on duration >= 15min and width >= 40px (REPEAT_ICON_MIN_DURATION_MINUTES / REPEAT_ICON_MIN_WIDTH) — an avatar badge needs equivalent space gating.
AllDayEventCard reserves pr-3.5 when the repeat icon shows so the title truncates first; a badge must participate in the same reservation logic.
Both cards use `cn` (classnames) + Tailwind 4 utility strings and @web/* path aliases.
